lead.event: Harta Djaya Karya plans rights issue to acquire a 45% stake in Trimata Coal Perkasa
lead.headline: MEJA plans Rp1.11 trillion rights issue for 45% stake in Trimata Coal Perkasa
lead.blurb: The share-swap offer has an indicative exercise price of Rp450–Rp550 a share, with TCP shareholders expected to absorb around 70% of the new shares. The valuation is based on an internal estimate and remains subject to an independent appraisal. MEJA is targeting shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting in February 2027, followed by OJK effectiveness and mining permits.

earnings_guidance.event: Telkom reports lower first-half 2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: TLKM reports first-half 2026 net profit down 7.67% to Rp9.96 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Telkom's revenue rose 4.12% to Rp75.88 trillion, while network operating, maintenance and telecommunication services expenses increased 9.15% to Rp21.47 trillion. Basic earnings per share fell to Rp100.75 from Rp108.85.

earnings_guidance.event: Tugu Insurance reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: TUGU reports nine-month profit up 17.4% to Rp495.15 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Tugu Insurance also recorded Insurance Service Revenue of Rp6.73 trillion, up 4.5% year on year, and Insurance Service Results of Rp602.04 billion, up 17.2%. President Director Adi Pramana said the company would continue its transformation through portfolio development, digital technology, risk management and human resource capabilities.

earnings_guidance.event: Prodia reports nine-month results and shareholder approval of a 1:5 stock split
earnings_guidance.headline: PRDA approves 1:5 stock split as nine-month net profit rises 10.0%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Prodia’s split reduces nominal value per share from Rp100 to Rp20, with outstanding shares projected to increase to 4.6875 billion from 937.5 million. For the nine months through September, revenue rose 8.3% to Rp1.71 trillion and EBITDA increased 9.7% to Rp340.2 billion; the theoretical post-split price is around Rp665 based on the 24 November close of Rp3,330.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI reports consumer loan growth and improved non-performing loan ratio
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI reports 9% consumer loan growth and a 2.9% NPL ratio
earnings_guidance.blurb: Consumer lending reached Rp242.9 trillion, versus Rp222.9 trillion a year earlier, with KPR up 13.1%, Multiguna 8.9% and KKB 302.8% year on year. The non-performing loan ratio fell from 3.1% to 2.9%, an improvement of 22 basis points.

deals_control.event: Tower Bersama agrees to acquire EDOTCO Infrastruktur Indonesia
deals_control.headline: TBIG agrees to acquire 100% of EDOTCO Infrastruktur Indonesia
deals_control.blurb: Tower Bersama signed a sale and purchase agreement with Axiata Group, EDOTCO Group and EDOTCO Malaysia. Completion remains subject to preliminary conditions in the agreement.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa launches a share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: INTP launches buyback worth up to Rp750 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Indocement will fund the buyback entirely from internal funds, capped at 10% of paid-in capital. The period runs from 22 May 2026 to 21 May 2027, and the withdrawal of 84.53 million treasury shares has been approved.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Cakra Buana Resources plans rights issue to convert promissory note receivables
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: CBRE plans rights issue of up to 48 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Cakra Buana Resources proposes using the proceeds to convert Rp858.59 billion of promissory note payables, including Rp354.06 billion owed to Garuda Nusantara Mineral. The company expects the conversion to reduce liabilities and increase equity. Shareholders are due to vote on the plan at an extraordinary meeting on 16 December 2026.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Rp354.06 billion of the debt conversion is owed to Garuda Nusantara Mineral.
